app.emptyHint: Choose a folder to get started.
app.confirmBody: These jobs are still running. Confirming will terminate them.
app.closeWindowBody.one: This window still has {n} tab open. Leaving will terminate all of its processes.
app.closeWindowBody.other: This window still has {n} tabs open. Leaving will terminate all of their processes.
app.stillRunningTerminal: The terminal still has jobs running.
app.openAllTitle: Open all favorites in this group
app.groupEmpty: This group has no favorites yet. Drag favorites here, or use the button below to favorite the current tab.
app.favoriteTabToGroup: + Favorite current tab in this group
app.name: Name
app.nameHelp: Leave empty to follow the current folder name.
app.shellPlaceholder: Leave empty to open a normal shell
app.tabCommandHelp: Runs only when this tab's main terminal starts. Changes take effect the next time it opens (restart the app or open from a favorite).
app.loadShellHelp: Uses the interactive shell from your Ghostty config; the shell stays open after the command ends.
app.loadShellHelpNext: Uses the interactive shell from your Ghostty config; the shell stays open after the command ends. Changes take effect the next time it opens.
app.tmuxHelpTab: Terminals keep running in the background after you quit the app; on the next launch this tab is restored and reattached to its tmux session. Each split uses its own session, and closing the tab manually also ends the session. Requires tmux; changes take effect the next time the tab opens.
app.tmuxHelpFavorite: Terminals keep running in the background after you quit the app; on the next launch they are restored and reattached to the tmux session. Requires tmux; changes take effect the next time it opens.
app.hideTmuxStatusHelpTab: Hides the green tmux status bar at the bottom of the terminal; applied immediately after saving.
app.hideTmuxStatusHelpFavorite: Hides the green tmux status bar at the bottom of the terminal; applied immediately to open tabs after saving.
app.favoriteTabHelp: Saves the current folder, split layout and launch command as a favorite, optionally into a group.
app.groupColorHelp: Tabs opened from this group are marked with this color in the workspace.
app.deleteGroupHelp: When a group is deleted, its favorites move to Ungrouped; they are not deleted.
app.favoriteTabSubtitle: Saves the current tab's folder, splits and launch command
app.favoriteFromDirSubtitle: Create a favorite from a folder
app.favoriteCommandHelp: Runs in the main terminal when the favorite opens.
app.favoritePathHelp: Only changes the main terminal's folder; the split layout stays as is.
app.updateLayoutHelp: Only writes the current split folders, layout and files panel state; name, command and tmux are unaffected.
app.removeFavoriteHelp: Removing a favorite does not close tabs that are already open.
app.snippetSubtitle: Save commands or text you use often
app.rulesUserBroken: The user rules file has errors; built-in rules are used instead.
app.alertBellHint: The terminal rang the bell; there is no other text.
app.alertStoppedHint: The title's running animation stopped; it may be waiting for your input.
app.currentTabInGroup: The current tab is in this group
app.tmuxExitedEarly: The tmux tab ended right after starting. The start command "{command}" may not be found; use an absolute path or check your PATH.
app.tmuxMissing: tmux not found. Please install it first (brew install tmux).
app.tmuxMissingRestore: tmux not found; tabs running in the background cannot be restored. Please install tmux (brew install tmux).
app.noFavorites: No favorites yet. Favorite the current tab from its edit page or the + above, or drag a folder from Finder here.
app.noUngroupedFavorites: No ungrouped favorites. Drag a favorite here to take it out of its group.
app.groupHasOpen: A favorite in this group is open
app.skipFolder: Skipped a folder that could not be opened: {path} ({error})
app.noTabForPreview: No tab to put the preview back into
app.coordinatorHelp: Pick a project, say what this terminal handles, then press the button to join it as a member. The tab must be running an agent (claude, codex, copilot or gemini) in tmux; leaving is done in the project view.
app.coordinatorNeedsAgent: This tab must be running claude, codex, copilot or gemini in tmux. Reopen it from a favorite with tmux on.
app.alreadyMember: This terminal is already a member of project "{project}".
app.coordinatorFavoriteHelp: Pick a project and say what this favorite handles: saving joins it as a member right away, even while its terminal is closed. The command must be an agent (claude, codex, copilot or gemini); tmux stays on. Open it from the project view or here when you need it.
app.joinCoordinatorHelp: Marks this tab as a project coordinator: tmux stays on and cannot be turned off, and the launch command can only be an agent chosen from the list (arguments stay free text). Takes effect the next time the tab opens.
app.answerChanged: The prompt changed before anything was sent, so nothing was pressed. Check the new one.
app.answerSent: Sent. Waiting for the screen to change.
